QuestInfo.name: Unprovoked Crow Attack
QuestInfo.1: When you entered the book, you found yourself in a forest full of cherry blossom trees. A strange man needs your help clearing crows out of his path.
QuestInfo.2: When you entered the book, you found yourself in a forest full of cherry blossom trees. A strange man needs your help clearing his path of crows. \nWhen you chase away the crows, he introduces himself as a merchant of Sakura Castle. He tells you to drop by if you're ever in town.
